sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.evidence: The May 20, 2025 entry explicitly releases gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20. The November 4 entry announces its November 18 shutdown. Separate entries distinguish native-audio and TTS previews.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5: Updates to our family of thinking models (June 17, 2025)
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The June 17, 2025 announcement explicitly says GA Gemini 2.5 Flash has no changes from the 05-20 preview and is the same underlying model. This is a direct count-preserving identity relationship, but the announcement supplies no numeric parameter count. Thinking budgets are supported.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 technical report
sources.evidence: Reopened the complete report downloaded October 27, 2026. Section 2.1 identifies sparse MoE Transformers and explains teacher-distribution distillation for Flash-size and smaller models. It gives no known-size student base or numeric total/active count. Table 1 includes Gemini 2.5 Flash capabilities, and other tables compare benchmark results rather than parameter sizes. The 22-billion and trillion-parameter mentions refer to cited vision-transformer and Switch Transformer research, not Gemini 2.5 Flash.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash model card (December 2025 revision)
sources.evidence: Reopened the complete December 2025 revision on October 27, 2026. The evaluation methodology explicitly names gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20. Architecture describes sparse routing qualitatively, with no expert count, activation fraction, total or active size. Tables distinguish GA Flash from April and September previews and separate image/audio variants; they do not disclose parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini models (indexed June 2025 documentation)
sources.evidence: Search-indexed primary page, crawled about 1.3 years ago, lists 05-20 as the Gemini 2.5 Flash preview version with 1,048,576 input tokens, 65,536 output tokens, multimodal input, thinking and function calling. Live opening now redirects to the current models index; used only for historical specifications.

sources.title: Intro to Gemini 2.5 Flash (pinned pre-GA notebook)
sources.evidence: Retrieved the official notebook revision before June 17, 2025. MODEL_ID is gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20 throughout examples for image, PDF (application/pdf), audio and video input, text responses, thinking budgets, and declared function calls.

sources.title: Gemini API deprecations
sources.evidence: Exact preview row records May 20, 2025 release and November 18, 2025 shutdown date. Fetched HTML gives this row class row-gray, which the page defines as already shut down; table dates alone are described as earliest possible shutdown dates.

sources.title: Vertex AI release notes
sources.evidence: The June 17, 2025 section says existing 2.5 preview endpoints, explicitly including 05-20 Flash, remain available until July 15, 2025 and shut down afterward. This is Vertex-specific, distinct from the Gemini API November schedule.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Current terms govern Gemini API/AI Studio access and prohibit extracting the underlying model weights. Supports a descriptive proprietary service classification, not an open-weight license; terms currently effective March 23, 2026.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash model card (December 2025)
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 later-disclosure check: the December 2025 Gemini 3 Flash card compares safety, tone and refusal performance to Gemini 2.5 Flash, with no parameter-size or activated-parameter column. It supplies no numeric count for the May 20 model.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 later-disclosure check of the complete current September 2026 card: Gemini 3.8 Flash explicitly derives from Gemini 3.7 Flash. Its comparisons contain no numeric total or active count for Gemini 2.5 Flash; the newer sibling relationship is not used to infer the older model size.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview model card (older URL)
sources.evidence: The older preview PDF returned HTTP 403 to both direct download and web open. The accessible later official Flash card and technical report were used instead.

sources.title: Models.dev baseline record
sources.evidence: Followed the baseline source link as a catalog lead. Technical claims in this report are grounded in Google documentation and research rather than this catalog.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash pricing and specifications
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model and 18B searches led to this page, opened October 27, 2026. It lists 18B total for stable Flash without a developer citation for that specification. Its source section documents pricing aggregation and its disclaimer covers third-party specifications. The explicit unchanged GA relationship would make a supported stable-model count applicable to the May preview, but this unsupported figure is not accepted.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Safety & Security Report, October 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 review of complete downloaded report text. Section 6.1.3, printed page 211, retrospectively describes Gemini 2.5 Flash as smaller than 2.5 Pro in an indirect-prompt-injection comparison, without a numeric parameter count. Other parameter occurrences concern security, evaluation or encoded knowledge; no total/active size for the May 20 preview or its unchanged GA model is disclosed.

name.note: Exact dated preview ID and model-card labeling support the existing display name.

developer.note: Developed by Google DeepMind; Google is the existing normalized developer.

family.note: Existing catalog family key corresponds to the Gemini Flash line.

release_date.note: Explicit launch date for this preview, distinct from the April 17 preview and June 17 GA endpoint.

open_weights.note: Google distributed this model through managed API/AI Studio services; no open-weight release or weight-download license was found in the official material reviewed.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the hosted Google model and its restrictive service terms, not an SPDX or downloadable-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-ID and model-name searches, reopened original evidence and later Google comparisons found no supported nominal total count. Google explicitly identifies the May 20 preview and June GA as unchanged, so a supported GA count would apply; none was found. SuperBased lists 18B without a developer source. The report describes distillation but no named count-bearing student base, and its cited 22B vision model is unrelated. Retain null.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-model active/activated-parameter searches and original/later primary-source comparisons found no numeric active count. MoE routing is qualitative, with no disclosed expert count or routing fraction. The unchanged GA identity is valid but supplies no number; later safety and benchmark tables contain no activated-parameter column. Retain null independently of total size.

architecture.note: Sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer, with native multimodal inputs. The explicit unchanged-to-GA statement ties the technical report to this preview; the later card also names its exact ID.

context_window.note: Historical input-token limit. The indexed June 2025 primary model table explicitly includes this preview. This is not a claim that the retired endpoint currently accepts requests, nor a sum of input and output limits.

modalities.note: Pinned official notebook uses this exact preview ID for each input format, including application/pdf. Output is text; native-audio, TTS and image-generation endpoints are separate variants.

reasoning.note: Exact-ID notebook demonstrates configurable thinking; the GA announcement confirms the unchanged model supports thinking budgets.

tool_call.note: Exact-ID official notebook demonstrates FunctionDeclaration and response.function_calls, corroborated by the historical capability table.

description.value: May 2025 Gemini 2.5 Flash preview with controllable thinking budgets; promoted unchanged to GA, with this preview endpoint now retired.
description.note: Preserves supported controllable thinking and adds the explicit GA identity and retired-preview distinction.

patch.notes: Google identifies the May 20, 2025 preview and June 17 GA release as the same model. Sparse MoE Transformer; total and active parameter counts are undisclosed in the reviewed sources. The 1,048,576-token input limit is historical. The Gemini API preview shut down November 18, 2025; Vertex AI ended preview availability after July 15. Native-audio, TTS, image and September previews are distinct variants.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit completed October 27, 2026. Total and active counts remain explicitly null after exact-ID/model-name searches, reopened original report/card and unchanged-GA announcement, and later Google comparisons. The valid GA identity does not supply an undisclosed size; the third-party 18B figure lacks developer support. Preserved all unrelated field assessments and corrections.
